categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the Internet of Things (IoT) sector, focusing on the research, development, and sales of IoT wireless communication modules, wireless communication terminals, communication solutions, and cloud products including cloud platforms and cloud infrastructure. Key segments include smart energy, vehicle networking, mobile broadband, and urban IoT sensing. The company also develops storage products and solutions for data centers and intelligent computing centers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include cellular communication, reliability technology, application layer protocols, baseband and RF technology, embedded software, and cloud platform technology. The company develops 4G, 5G, NB-IoT, V2X wireless communication modules and solutions, and has proprietary technologies such as embedded lightweight virtualization software and Sub-1GHz WiFi HaLow IoT technology. Production is outsourced to contract manufacturers mainly in the Pearl River Delta region, with the company controlling key processes and protecting core technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are government and enterprise clients in smart energy (including electric power, water, and gas), vehicle networking (automotive and two-wheeled electric vehicles), mobile broadband, and urban IoT sensing sectors. The company serves large state-owned enterprises like State Grid and Southern Grid, automotive manufacturers, telecom operators, and cloud service providers. Major markets include domestic Chinese cities and overseas regions such as Southeast Asia, Europe, North America, and India.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant presence in Shenzhen, Dongguan, and Xi'an for R&D and operations. It also has overseas markets in Southeast Asia (e.g., Malaysia, India), Europe, North America, and the Middle East. Overseas sales include direct exports and sales through multinational distributors. Overseas assets account for about 3.93% of total assets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the IoT supply chain, focusing on module and terminal product development and sales, as well as cloud platform and infrastructure solutions. It procures key components such as baseband chips and RF chips from upstream semiconductor manufacturers and electronic component distributors, including Qualcomm, Unisoc, and domestic chip suppliers. Manufacturing is outsourced, while R&D and sales are in-house.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing 5G and 6G wireless communication technologies, expanding cloud platform and cloud infrastructure capabilities, and deepening integration of IoT with big data, AI, and cloud computing. The company invests heavily in R&D (12.34% of revenue), focusing on 4G/5G modules, V2X solutions, lightweight virtualization software, and distributed high-performance storage systems. It aims to lead in smart energy, vehicle networking, urban sensing, and cloud infrastructure markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of wireless communication modules, terminals, communication solutions, and cloud products. The company uses direct sales and distribution channels, with some service and solution contracts involving customized development and deployment. Revenue recognition follows delivery and customer acceptance, with some technical service income recognized upon completion and acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the smart energy wireless communication module market, especially in China and parts of Southeast Asia and Europe. It is a pioneer in smart grid communication modules and has a strong presence in vehicle networking and urban IoT sensing. Competitors include other IoT module manufacturers and solution providers, with some peers experiencing revenue declines in the global IoT module market. The company differentiates through integrated cloud and edge solutions and domestic chip integration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 931.9 million, an 11% increase year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 38.4 million, improving by 32% compared to the previous year. Total assets grew 14.78% to RMB 1.57 billion, while net assets slightly decreased by 3.72% to RMB 745.1 million. R&D investment increased by 8.41% to RMB 115 million, representing 12.34% of revenue. The company continues to expand its market presence domestically and internationally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes providing globally leading, reliable IoT access communication products and solutions that enable environmental sustainability, efficiency, and convenience. Its competitive differentiation lies in deep industry understanding, advanced core technologies, and integrated cloud-edge-terminal solutions that cover data collection, transmission, processing, and storage. The company offers secure, stable, and autonomous products, particularly in smart energy, vehicle networking, and urban sensing, supported by strong R&D and a broad patent portfolio.
